name: light-research via the plugin deep-research skill with worker dispatch
purpose: Tier A/B worker dispatch fires, cited report written under the rep project dir
prompt: no-interview light-research: Using the bioresearcher-deep-research plugin skill, survey the recent article landscape on BRCA1 DNA repair. Cite sources with PMIDs.

checks.desc: worker dispatch fired (Tier A preferred, Tier B acceptable)

anyOf.desc: Tier A: dedicated worker agent spawned

checks.desc: at least one aspect report written under the rep project dir

checks.flag: dispatch-and-completeness: adjudicate from firedArms which anyOf arm fired (arm 1 = dr-worker subagent_stats, arm 2 = Task(subagent_type) input, arm 3 = generic fallback). If not a dr-worker arm, check whether Tier B inlining was used by design, or whether the worker failed to read its ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} references (PLUGIN_ROOT degradation) and silently fell back. Also record completeness: how many aspect files exist and whether reports/**/final_report.md was synthesized (light-research sessions near the budget cap may legitimately stop after aspect reports — the machine checks only require one aspect file plus citations).
